packageRules.description: AppKit's packages are released in step, and the template pins them to one version.
Tools pinned in mise.toml (Node, pnpm, the Databricks CLI) are exact versions.
The libraries Chromium needs on Linux, pinned in pixi.toml to exact conda-forge versions, with pixi.lock refreshed beside them.
Actions stay pinned to a full commit digest, with the version in a comment.
